:::{#exm-zhz-sum-squares}
#### Computing $\vecf{z}^{\mathsf{H}}\vecf{z}$

Let $\vecf{z} = \tp{(1 + i, 2)}$.
By @thm-zhz-sum-squares,

$$
\ba
\underbrace{\vecf{z}^{\mathsf{H}}}_{1 \times 2}\,\underbrace{\vecf{z}}_{2 \times 1}
&= \abs{1 + i}^2 + \abs{2}^2
&& \text{(@thm-zhz-sum-squares)}
\\
&= (1^2 + 1^2) + (2^2 + 0^2)
&& \text{(definition of the absolute value, squared)}
\\
&= 2 + 4
&& \text{(add inside each group)}
\\
&= 6
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

Multiplying out directly gives the same number:
$\overline{2} \cd 2 = 4$, and

$$
\ba
\overline{(1 + i)}\,(1 + i)
&= (1 - i)(1 + i)
&& \text{(conjugate)}
\\
&= 1 + i - i - i^2
&& \text{(distribute)}
\\
&= 1 - i^2
&& \text{(cancel } i \text{)}
\\
&= 2
&& \text{(} i^2 = -1 \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
